title: Smart Budgets Q1 Planning
summary: The team confirmed the Premium product will launch on February 1 without the shared‑budget feature, which is now slated for a mid‑April Q2 release. Push notifications for budget alerts are on track to ship on December 8, replacing email‑only alerts while keeping the weekly summary email unchanged. A single Premium subscription will cover both partners in a shared budget, and two additional backend engineers have been approved with Aisha leading hiring. Action items include updating the sales deck, adjusting onboarding materials, and documenting architecture for the new hires.
key_points: Premium launch set for February 1 without shared budgets
Shared‑budget feature moved to Q2 with target mid‑April
Push notifications for budget alerts ship December 8; weekly email remains
One Premium subscription covers both partners in a shared budget
Two backend engineers approved; Aisha to lead interviews and onboarding
